idea-plugin.name: Model Name
idea-plugin.description:
Tells you what an AI model ID actually means. Put the caret on (or select) something like claude-opus-4-1-20250805, gpt-4.1-mini or meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free, right click, and pick Parse AI Model ID.

You get the vendor, family, version, size, release date and tags:

  • claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 → Anthropic · Claude Sonnet · 3.5, date 2024-10-22
  • qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b → Alibaba · Qwen · 3, size 235b-a22b
  • Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview → Google · Gemini Pro · 3.1, preview

It reads API IDs and display names the same way, so old and new names land in the same family. Works offline, no API keys, no network calls.

The naming rules come from the same parser behind the Whizi AI model directory. To see what each model costs per message, check the AI model cost index. Source: github.com/BoNour/modelname-intellij.

action.description: Show the vendor, family and version of the AI model ID under the caret
